instruction: Adjust VLC's volume settings to allow boosting sound up to 200% instead of the usual maximum.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting VLC maximum volume to 200% (qt-max-volume=200). Uses existing check_qt_max_volume metric function and get_vlc_config getter. The evaluator reads vlcrc config file and checks if qt-max-volume is set to 200. Similar complexity to original task - changing a single VLC configuration setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checking if VLC maximum volume is set to 200%
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly reads the VLC config file (vlcrc) from OS-specific location
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses the config file and extracts qt-max-volume setting
Expected value (200) matches the instruction requirement exactly
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config file is written and can be read
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact requirement from the instruction
Edge cases handled: missing config file, missing setting (uses default '125'), type conversion
Data flow is correct: getter extracts right file -> metric checks right setting -> comparison uses correct expected value
